Entry Crisis Response of Dorne When Dorne faces a crisis, the most reliable thing is not the legendary hero, but the long-term way of survival. In a crisis, dispersed terrain and resilient kinship networks can provide resilience, but water and supplies will always determine how far resistance can go; this also determines what local people will do for If a rule is practiced over and over again, it will find its way into rituals, crafts, and prayers; if it is sustained only by fear, cracks will show at the onset of a crisis.
